reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00403EF0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/go/00403EF0-GOSoundMusic.cpp at sha256 0cc3d91185e6bd3e54f17acceaa6126639a7665e87c56111ffc236e972bea2b6 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t GOSoundMusic(long param_1, int32_t param_2, float param_3);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, int32_t arg2, float arg3 @ 0xc)" at 0x00403EF0; radare2 recovers "fcn.00403ef0 (int32_t arg_28h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00403EF0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t GOSoundMusic(long param_1, int32_t param_2, float param_3);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
